hooks.text: Causality Cards可偷看对手手牌，并在关键时刻把废牌暗换成同花或三条逆转牌局
hooks.excerpt: This unique version of poker, infused with a twist, allows you, equipped with a system, to peer into your opponent's hand using "Causality Cards." At critical moments, you can secretly swap out "junk cards" for winning hands like flushes or three-of-a-kinds, turning the tide of the game!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 刮刮卡会随机决定做饭食材、穿搭、住房和车辆，把城市生存变成一套运气驱动的生活模拟
hooks.excerpt: From chocolate-spiced chili to creamy steamed eggplant, whether you can whip up a decent "dish" depends entirely on your luck. Your fashion sense, whether it’s a suit paired with yoga pants or a pleated skirt with a grandpa tank top, is dictated by what you can scratch off. You can also scratch for housing, furniture, electric bikes, and cars...
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 九名来自不同社会阶层的恋爱对象各有复杂背景，可选择伴侣共同揭开River Town隐藏秘密
hooks.excerpt: Across various sectors—work, sports, healthcare, cuisine, and gaming—nine romantic interests from different social strata await. Each character embodies both good and evil, resistance and struggle, with their own intricate backstories. Choose your life partner and join hands with them to uncover the hidden secrets of River Town.
